jobs.description: OverviewWe are a cutting-edge Defense Innovation Company seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our engineering organization and raise the bar for quality across our web application portfolio. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving manufacturing and product lifecycle quality by implementing a risk-based approach to ensure compliance with corporate policies, 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, and other applicable regulatory standards, while championing continuous improvement. You will play a pivotal role in New Product Introduction (NPI) and Change Control processes, ensuring accurate and complete quality deliverables during design transfer to manufacturing. This includes reviewing change orders and deviations to confirm clear, well-documented rationales and comprehensive impact assessments for significant changes. By developing robust qualification strategies, you will proactively mitigate risks associated with design and process modifications, enhancing product reliability and supporting innovative product development.This position reports to the Sr Manager of Quality Engineering and is part of the Quality Engineering Team located in Sunnyvale and/or Newark, CA, and will be an on-site role.In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity ToLead day-to-day quality engineering support for medical device manufacturing operations, including oversight of plastic part design, manufacturing equipment performance, and quality inspections.Serve as the primary Quality Engineering representative on cross-functional teams for new product introduction and manufacturing sustainment, providing strategic input on design control, risk management, and quality compliance.Drive risk assessment activities including safety, design and process FMEA(s), with a focus on interpretation of quality requirements, verification/validation planning and execution, first production run requirements, and potential problem resolution. Develop and review project documentation such as quality plan, validation master plan, risk management plan, quality control plan, IQ/OQ/PQ/PV protocols and reports to ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements and Cepheid Quality Management

If you’re passionate about driving process, excellence and product quality in a dynamic industrial setting, trust the experts at hiring experts to take your engineering career to the next level.OverviewOur client is a leader in advanced aluminum casting, serving a diverse range of industries. As a Quality Engineer, you’ll apply professional engineering principles to develop, implement, and continuously improve product and process quality systems. You’ll support compliance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and ISO 14001 while championing initiatives in customer satisfaction, scrap reduction, and process stability. This hands-on role maintains a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and leads APQP, PPAP, customer interface, metrology, and technical investigations.ResponsibilitiesMaintain and improve ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and ISO 14001 management systems—including internal audits, corrective actions, and document control.Lead APQP activities for new product launches, engineering changes, and process changes (dimensional validation, capability studies, Gage R&R, documentation, and submissions).Lead and support customer, internal, and third-party audit activities.Lead root cause investigations for customer complaints, scrap, dimensional, and process issues. Support containment and verification of corrective actions.Analyze manufacturing data and trends to identify opportunities for scrap reduction, process improvement, and increased capability.Support process validation and technical quality activities for low pressure, counterpressure, gravity/tilt pour, and secondary operations.Collaborate in developing and maintaining PFMEAs, Process Flow Diagrams, Work Instructions, and Control Plans.Lead supplier quality activities such as technical evaluations, supplier corrective actions, and improvement projects.Program, validate, and optimize CMM inspection routines using PC-DMIS software; support metrology planning and dimensional analysis.Utilize CMM, laser scanning, x-ray, liquid penetrant, and other inspection systems for product and process evaluation.Perform SPC, process capability analysis, and Gage R&R studies; support calibration system and calibration data analysis.Implement continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, supporting process discipline, technical troubleshooting, and operator engagement.QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or related field—or equivalent experience2–5 years of manufacturing quality engineering experienceExperience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC methodologiesKnowledge of ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949, and ISO 14001, including internal auditing and correct
